about.heading: A Jewellery House Built on Trust
about.shortIntro: Fine gold, diamond and silver jewellery from the heart of Jammu.
about.description:
Vardhman Jewellers is a family-run jewellery house in Talab Tillo, Jammu, serving generations of families with hallmarked gold, certified diamond and fine silver jewellery.

Every piece in our showroom is selected for its craftsmanship and purity. We believe jewellery is not merely an ornament — it is a memory, an investment and a blessing that passes from one generation to the next.

Visit our showroom to experience our wedding and everyday collections in person. Our team will gladly walk you through purity, hallmarking and transparent pricing for every article.
